summary: Implement ISO/IEC 42001 with practical AIMS tools, risk methods, and audit-ready templates. Train your team for accountable AI governance.
lede: Implementing ISO/IEC 42001 AI Management Systems gives you a structured way to define scope, assess AI risks and impacts, select controls, and demonstrate leadership oversight. The course connects ISO/IEC 42001:2023 with Annex A controls and Annex B guidance so you can build an Artificial Intelligence Management System supported by clear evidence. Practice drafting scope statements, mapping risks to controls, maintaining governance records, controlling documented information, and preparing for performance evaluation and management review. You will also explore how AI management can align with ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 31000, helping address incomplete inventories, evolving data governance, overlapping obligations, and fast-moving generative AI use cases.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to implement ISO/IEC 42001 AI Management Systems in real operating environments, align AI governance with existing controls, and produce audit-ready evidence.
prerequisites: You should already have a working knowledge of organizational risk, policy development, or management systems such as ISO/IEC 27001 or ISO 31000. No programming is required, but you should be comfortable reading governance documents, interpreting control requirements, and working with spreadsheets or document templates. Prior exposure to AI use cases, internal audit, compliance, or information security will help you move faster, but it is not mandatory. Advanced topics are taught at an operational application level, not as technical engineering or model-building.
